name: Sort a laundry load
short_description: Separate ten washable items by care needs using their material and care information.
self_assessment: I can sort ten washable items into compatible loads without help.
description: Separate ten washable items by care needs using their material and care information. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Separate delicate, dark, and high-temperature items

builds_on.note: Reading care information supports accurate sorting.
